notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn Final Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png

This game has been an astronomical pain in the ass. It's just not cooperative with any and most changes I've made to it and it's gone through a lot of hardship, bugs and issues. Unfortunately, due to some incompatibility of the plugins and the program itself. Some changes JUST don't want to work with me. It's not that I haven't fixed the issue or checked 10-20 times. It's that when I do fix the issue, the program outwardly fails to acknowledge that anything has in fact changed. So nothing does.

So for a big issue that takes place in chapter 4. The fix is this:

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/67c3268e58d9cdddf0493b8f7f46b07c2bcbbf7d.png

There is a tall snow tree on the right side of the village of oteskta. Interact with it on the right side, facing left. You can then enter the code; 719. (This should only be used if you get sent back to chapter 3 if you are already on chapter 4). Ignore the tree if you are on chapter 2 and can progress through the village to chapter 3 just fine.

This game has already obtained several silent updates, fixing other issues pertaining to this error and several others.

*There is a glitch that allows Thedo and the gang to teleport to chapter 5 through the school in chapter 2. While you can use this to practically speed run the game. You miss out of a lot of story including character deaths and all the important side quests, unlockables and content. So unless your mission as Thedo is to go to the school. Don't go to the school any earlier than you have to.*

Yes, this issue has been attempted to be fixed several times, yes nothing can be done about it, due to the program.

Unfortunately these issues are here and nothing can be done about them, except working around them.

In other news, Euclyca is a game that needs my full undivided attention and is a lot of work. I'm only one person and this SE II bs is really tearing me down. I wish I could tell you that the fixes I applied multiple times had actually worked. But, they don't. But, just like the first game in the series, no matter what I try to do to fix it, just seems to not want to budge. Gotta say, this program is a hassle and a half sometimes.


Lastly; here is what is new:

-2 doom blasters in the tree.


*I cannot say that this officially counts as an update as it is lackluster in content. But, what I can say is that it now provides a way for everyone to safety beat the game from start to finish. Which is probably one of the most, if not the most important thing to come to any game in an update.

I know it's hard, but if you survived 2020, you can survive this game.

Tomorrow is the last chance to pick up this donation DLC;
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1343980/Solenars_Edge_II_Aurora_of_The_Seventh_Dawn_Nelditus_Donation/

If you feel like my continuous hard work is worth rewarding, I won't stop you. Either way, thanks.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn v1.3 update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png

Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn v1.3 final update.

This update was made possible by a poll in the past taken by a few users
who voted for their favorite Team Syukino game.
The winner was this game.

Because of this, the following things have been added in;


-The cave dungeon from Estellium Legends is now on the Alcornagia world map.
-The Imp boss from Estellium Legends is a secret boss in the cave.
-Clairena Almstead from Aeloren Tactics is a new unlockable character in the
end game resort.



*Fixes*
-Fixed Armeida Tactics so it would work. If it causes anymore issues, it will
be removed in the future and placed as a free download on Itch.io.

*This fix would have happened regardless but it would have appeared as a hotfix and not a content update.

notes.title: Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn v1.2 Update!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/7e33dbd7e1f6b0d1d305f4edbd31b43e9dd0f858.png


Welcome to the next update of Solenars Edge v1.2.

I hope those who got to play the game are enjoying it!

Without wasting anymore time, let us dive in!



-Added in the Staff of Alnestia. It is a rare loot drop that is
only found once in the game. It contains a new spell called;
Alnestia's Blessing.

-Added in Alnestia's Blessing via the Staff of Alnestia.
Fully heals, restores 15% MP, Gains 10 TP,
Adds MP Regen, Mdf and Mat for all allies.
*You need 550 MP and 30 TP to cast it*

-Added in the last secret boss; Gabriel the Fallen.
He can be found in the end-game resort.

-Extended a certain character's scene in the forrest of memories.

-You can now buy a fishing rod from the school supplier.

-Added in the last outfit for Aionis; Dark Knight Set.
Based off of Scel from Tales of Beasteria.

-Added in six new characters in the end-game arena.

-Orkeida (Last Song/Tutorial).
-Ralna (SER)
-Solen (SER)
-Maribelle (SER)
-Phyrith (SER)
-Felm (Falnarion Tactics).

*There is now a total of around 62 playable characters in the game.

-Added in Marribelle's Kid Version in the
appearence change vender.

-Outfit/Secret boss added into the guide.

-Added in Leonard's Younger Version in the
appearence change vender.

-Added in some hidden goodies.


*Minor fixes*

-Fixed Leafen's skillset to reflect more grass type moves.

-Changed Kilken's weapons to Golem Fist Xs which include his voice SE.

-Added in Zero to the special thanks in the credits.

-Slightly buffed the Glacious weapons.

-Changed Melvin's skillset a bit and buffed him.

-Buffed the skill; Roundhouse Kick.

-Fixed the animation for Flame Strike.

-Buffed Thedo's attack damage and magic attack damage including the weapons he uses.

-Closed off the polls for the character submission forum.

-Fixed some of Atsumora's dialogue.

-Removed the chest on the world map that contained a stylus that
prevented the player from continuing the story on the second return
of the world map.

-Fixed the cutscene at the start in the school where Aionis didn't walk all
the way to the Teacher. (This was intentional at first, but I realized it
looks better this way).

-Fixed a scene in the Forrest of Memories where Aionis would appear twice.

*I hope to make a walkthrough for the game in the near future to help
those who need it.

**Earlier this month, the internet went out and the Stream was cancelled.
I've been streaming the game ever since on Twitch about a week after.
I'm on chapter 4 out of 6. I plan to finish it entirely. You can
check up on game-play you've missed in the previous streams and stay
tuned for the continuation of the stream coming around 6:50pm EST.

https://www.twitch.tv/team_syukino

notes.title: SEII: AoTSD v1.1 Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37429407/205ccf0155272893b634a545843b68e2eb3ed67a.png

Hello and welcome to a big update for Solenars Edge II: Aurora of The Seventh Dawn.

Lets waste no time and dive in to see whats been changed:


-The buy button is back on the Steam Store page.

-The two doom blasters at the start of a new game for the demo players have been removed.

-The first boss has been nerfed a bit, easier to kill, faster to get through the chapter.

-A new shop in the end game resort has been added in and it allows certain characters to
change their appearence and classes with items.

-Five new characters have been added in as Mercenaries in the end game resort;
Oren (SER), Momo (FT), Alia (EL), Big Beef Gai (SER), Luminarus (SEH and Last Song).

-Added in Solenars Edge: Last Song.
Solenars Edge: Last Song is a short playable side story featuring Luminarus, Atsumora and Zephyr.
It is separate from the main game and can be launched when you start up a new game.

-Fixed the cost of the Thunder Slap skill.

-Fixed the annoying thunderstorm background noise that would follow you everywhere
once you beat the BFC Mini-Game.

-Fixed the plant so it can actually be cut down so it's no longer blocking access to
the Bomb Brigade Mini-Game and a chest.

-Fixed the Standby skill in Armeida Tactics as it did not give 10 tp per use.

-Added in an optional tutorial at the start of a new game for people to play.

*The livestream did happen and another one will happen on the 16th!
